title: Toy sorting cards, six pictures of objects
subject: History
unit: Spring 2: Childhood within living memory (Memory Box)
source: Seeded from history/y1 lesson 3 (Toy sorting cards, six pictures of objects (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 3: Toys long ago and today. To understand how toys have changed within living memory

cards:
artefact
an object from the past

old
made a long time ago

living memory
what people alive now can
remember

grandparent
the parent of your mum or dad
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: Old or new: a tablet game?
questions.model: Does it need a battery or a screen? Yes. Screens are new. So it is new.

questions.q: What is a wooden top made of?
Old or new: marbles in a cloth bag?
questions.a: Old (they are still played today too)

questions.q: Sort six toy pictures into 'long ago' and 'today'.
questions.a: Long ago: wooden top, marbles, skipping rope; today: tablet game, plastic robot, remote-control car
questions.model: Teacher does the first card: wooden top, made of wood, no battery, goes in 'long ago'.

questions.q: Write what one old toy is made of.
questions.a: For example: The top is made of wood

questions.q: Which toy would you choose and why?
Big question: would a toy from long ago still be fun today?
questions.a: For example: yes, a spinning top is still fun because you can race it
